name: product-subnav
title: Product subnav
description: A product's local navigation: its name set large above the links, then a 56px sticky bar with the name, the links and one action once you scroll.
docs: Pass name, tagline, links ({ label, href }), an action, currentHref, mode, offset and linkAs. It renders two siblings, the intro and the bar, so put it directly in the element that holds the page: a sticky bar stays for as long as its parent is on screen. The intro is the name set large with the tagline (nameAs picks the element: p by default, h1 on the overview page). The bar is 56px from md up and sticks at offset pixels from the top, the height of your main navbar; once it has reached its place the name appears at its left, with the links in the middle and the action at the right. In pages mode (the default) the links go to the product's other pages and the current one carries aria-current="page". In anchors mode they are fragment links to sections of the page: the bar follows the scroll with aria-current="location", scrolls to a section with the navbar and the bar cleared (smoothly, or at once under reduced motion), and moves focus to its heading; give the sections a scroll-margin as tall as both for visitors who arrive with the hash in the address. On a phone the bar is two rows: the name above, and under it a row of links that scrolls sideways with fading edges and holds the action pinned at its right end, so the button stays level with the links before the name arrives and after. The links of pages mode are rendered on the server, so a Server Component can pass its router's Link as linkAs.
